name: Inner-City Muslim Action Network
mission: The Inner-City Muslim Action Network (IMAN) is a community organization that fosters health, wellness and healing in the inner-city by organizing for social change, cultivating the arts, and operating a holistic health center. We incorporated as a nonprofit in 1997 through the drive of people directly affected by and deeply invested in social issues affecting communities of color living on Chicago's South Side. Since that time, we have steadily grown and, in 2016, opened a second office in Atlanta to continue mobilizing a cross-section of people committed to this mission. The organization models an integrative approach that employs holistic interventions to address a spectrum of structural and systemic injustices impeding a dignified quality of life for people in marginalized communities.

rich_narrative.summary: founded in 1997, the Inner-City Muslim Action Network (IMAN) is a community-based organization that addresses the complex needs of marginalized populations in Chicago and Atlanta. The organization operates with a <cite id="1">94/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting a high standard of accountability and leadership. In FY2024, IMAN reported <cite id="5">total revenue of $18,475,567</cite>, representing a <cite id="5">three-year revenue growth rate of 17.3%</cite>. This financial growth supports a diverse service model that includes the <cite id="1">IMAN Health Center, Green ReEntry housing, and food ecosystem initiatives</cite>. While the organization maintains <cite id="1">9.9 months of working capital</cite>, providing a significant safety net for operations, its <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 65.9%</cite> is considered moderate. IMAN is particularly noted for its <cite id="1">high fundraising efficiency</cite>, spending only <cite id="1">$0.03 to raise every $1</cite>. The organization’s <cite id="2">zakat-eligible status</cite> makes it a key destination for Muslim donors looking to support domestic poverty alleviation and social justice within an Islamic framework.
